a.xlink:title: segment 2.3. A named, ordered assembly of veritoids. The unit of naming, of writing, of whole review.
segment_name 2.4. A label the store keeps bound to a segment.
veritoid 2.1. A piece of content of a declared kind. Everything in this table is written by an author.
reference 2.5. A written pointer. All predicated-on rows together are the dependency graph (no cycles).
projection_member 2.6. Chosen groupings with an order. Distinct from the dependency graph.
inbox_item Part 5. Each segment's intake. Not part of what the segment says. (Shown here only because it sits beside the segment at rest.)
value COMPUTED, never written. One per subject per open dimension. Shown so the picture has somewhere for dimensions to attach.
